answer.title: Count files in the study folder
What kinds of files are in the study folder?

answer.none: The Mini cannot list your Drive folders; it can only list files within specific folders or describe the contents of files.

answer.title: List all files in the study folder

answer.none: The Mini cannot directly compare data from two separate files or perform calculations across them; it can only describe, list, or summarize individual files.
The Mini cannot create charts or perform data analysis on the stored files; it can only read, describe, or summarize their contents.
